LAREDO, Texas — Francisco Garcia-Lopez was arrested early Friday morning, October 23, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged third-degree felony charge of driving while intoxicated, third or more, according to Webb County booking records.

Garcia-Lopez was arrested at 4:07 a.m. The booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956 listed him as held on an out-of-county hold for U.S. Customs and Border Protection. No bond was set.

The booking listing indicated two charge rows for the booking, but the individual detail view reviewed by Webb Watch 956 showed a single offense record — driving while intoxicated, third or more, a third-degree felony.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Francisco Garcia-Lopez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
